cd "C:/Users/LAUTI_~1/AppData/Local/Temp/cdb-b-idem-replay-original-2-tqpoi6oo/ws" && python - <<'EOF'
p='src/intake.py'
s=open(p).read()
old='''def storage_key(hook: Webhook) -> str:
    # Choose the idempotency identity for this delivery
    if hook.provider in HEADER_KEY_PROVIDERS and hook.idempotency_key:
        return hook.idempotency_key[:_KEY_PREFIX]
    return hook.event_id
'''
new='''def storage_key(hook: Webhook) -> str:
    # Choose the idempotency identity for this delivery. Retries carry a new
    # event id but the same Idempotency-Key, so the header wins when present.
    # Keys are scoped per provider so two providers can't collide.
    if hook.idempotency_key:
        key = hook.idempotency_key
        if hook.provider in HEADER_KEY_PROVIDERS:
            key = key[:_KEY_PREFIX]
        return f"{hook.provider}:key:{key}"
    return f"{hook.provider}:event:{hook.event_id}"
'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace('''# Some providers double-credit if they use the normal key. Keep them on the
# short header key. If another provider double-credits, add it here.
# Do not remove — been this way since the 2024 retry incident.''','''# Legacy: these providers are deduplicated on a short prefix of the header
# key rather than the full key. Do not remove — been this way since the 2024
# retry incident. Do not add new providers here: every provider already
# dedupes on its full Idempotency-Key, and a prefix can merge distinct payouts.''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat >> tests/test_intake.py <<'EOF'


def test_harbor_retry_with_a_new_event_id_is_not_applied_twice():
    intake = Intake()
    first = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    again = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844.2", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    assert first.applied is True
    assert again.applied is False
    assert again.duplicate is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 18_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 1


def test_header_keys_sharing_a_prefix_are_distinct_payouts():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6", amount=18_000))
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_2", "8f3c1a9eaaaaaaaa", amount=2_000))
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 20_000


def test_same_key_from_different_providers_does_not_collide():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1", "shared-key-0001", amount=100))
    other = intake.apply(hook("lumen", "po_9", "shared-key-0001", amount=50))
    assert other.applied is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 150
EOF
